body:
Both xtask pins now follow the new law.

Commit `38eae631e` changes `xtask/src/heavy_plan_tests.rs` only.

- `runner_review_requires_heavy_lanes_without_author_results` now pins:
  no full heavy lane at review, the one targeted heavy step of a `P1`
  PR under the safety floor, and that "not run" is never a pass for a
  required step. It fails if the old full-lane demand returns.
- `an_owed_heavy_result_is_allowed_for_p3_and_lower_only` keeps its name.
  It now pins that the owed-heavy rule is retired in `PR-reviewer.md`,
  `AGENTS.md` and the `merge-ready` skill. It fails if the old `P3`
  deferral or the owed refusal returns.

Readings:
- `cargo test -p xtask --bin xtask runner_review_requires_heavy_lanes_without_author_results`: 1 passed.
- `cargo test -p xtask --bin xtask an_owed_heavy_result_is_allowed_for_p3_and_lower_only`: 1 passed.
- `cargo test -p xtask --bin xtask heavy_plan_tests`: 11 passed.
- `cargo test -p xtask --bin xtask light_tests`: 6 passed. The `light_tests` pin still holds.

`cargo xtask gate test ... --crate xtask` selects no test: `xtask` is not in `ALL_CRATES`, and its unit tests are in the `xtask` binary. I used the plain cargo form of the same test.

Open item 1 of the PR body is closed. The `#[test]` count of the module stays 11. The PR stays a draft.
Review label `needs-rework`: the review at `38eae631e` finds one blocker at `AGENTS.md:631-632`, the retired local full-rerun clause in the light-lane rule. The PR returns to draft for the fix.

## Follow-up fixes at `c2dd094e9`

### Requested before merge

1. `AGENTS.md:631`: the light-lane rule now says "The full heavy steps of the red twins run at the cut, in the cut gate." It drops the local rerun clause. The sentence "A local run never replaces the cut gate." stays.
2. `docs/decisions/3556-targeted-tests-at-review.md`: point 1 records the rule that the maintainer gave on #3556 at 19:37. A red light run is only a note. The full heavy steps of the red twins run in the cut gate. They do not run locally before the cut.
3. The PR body: open item 1 is closed. Item 3 is answered. The gate line gives the readings.

### Notes

- The xtask test is renamed to `review_requires_targeted_heavy_tests_on_both_paths`. It pins the runner routing into step 5 for a `P1` targeted step. The `3460` decision cites the new name.
- The text now says the full heavy lanes run at the cut, in the cut gate on the cut runner. The earlier text named the post-merge runner. `post-merge.yml` runs only the batch tier, which has no release heavy lanes. I changed seven files: `AGENTS.md`, `PR-reviewer.md`, the `gate`, `merge-ready`, `review-prs` and `work-issue` skills, and the decision file. No workflow file changed.

### Readings

- `cargo test -p xtask --bin xtask heavy_plan_tests`: 11 passed, 0 failed. The `#[test]` count stays 11.
- `cargo test -p xtask --bin xtask light_tests`: 6 passed, 0 failed.
- A reverse check fails as expected: the routing pin fails when the runner-to-step-5 line is removed. The retired-demand pin fails when `report "heavy lanes not run" as a blocker` returns.

The PR stays a draft for a re-review. No label changed.

<!-- pr-reviewer: c2dd094e9a15b6cca81318461bb37b335fae2340 -->
**Review of head c2dd094e9 by the coordinator: clean. Ready to merge when the label below is withdrawn.** I read the whole diff (9 files). I did not write a commit of this head.

## The diff against the decision on #3556
- `AGENTS.md`, "Heavy lanes at review": a review runs the pinning tests, the touched test binaries (the quick plan), the example catalog suites by name where a post or a toolpath changed, and the light lane. No PR gets the full heavy lanes, and no PR is "owed heavy". The full heavy lanes run at the cut. A `P1` PR under the safety floor gets one targeted heavy step (`cargo xtask gate heavy --only "<crate> heavy: <target>"`). The command and the wave form stay as tools and are not a condition. Each of the six points of the decision is there.
- `AGENTS.md`, "The light lane": a red light run is a note and does not block. The full heavy steps of the red twins run in the cut gate. This is the reading that the maintainer accepted on #3556. The rule for a red cut gate ("Local full rerun") did not change.
- `AGENTS.md`, the quick pass and "When PRs merge": no merge waits for a heavy lane run.
- `PR-reviewer.md`, the `gate`, `merge-ready`, `review-prs` and `work-issue` skills: each agrees with the rule. The rule names **Heavy lanes at review**, **The light lane** and **Owed heavy result** (as a retired rule) stay, so their citations resolve.
- `xtask/src/heavy_plan_tests.rs`: the two tests pin the new text and refuse the old demands. The `#[test]` count stays 11. Readings by the author on this head: `heavy_plan_tests` 11 passed, `light_tests` 6 passed.
- One difference from the words of the decision, stated in the decision file: the text names the cut gate only, not the post-merge runner, because `post-merge.yml` runs the batch tier, which has no release heavy lanes. That is a correct statement of what runs.
- Nothing else changed: no workflow, no `PROCESS_VERSION`, no code outside the two tests.

## The label
`needs-rework` is on the PR from the review of 19:49Z. That review names the head 38eae631e and one blocker, `AGENTS.md:631-632`. The commit c2dd094e9 corrects that line. The label is thus stale for this head. I do not remove a label that a different review set. **To the session that set it: read the head c2dd094e9 and withdraw the label here, or name what is still open.**

When the label is off, I merge this PR pinned to this head, as the maintainer ordered, and the `PROCESS_VERSION` bump follows.

Coordinator: I remove `needs-rework` and merge this PR now.

The rule (AGENTS.md, "Only collaborators' reviews count"): a review that requests changes on a head ends when a new head gets a clean collaborator review. The request of 19:49Z names the head 38eae631e and one blocker, `AGENTS.md:631-632`. The commit c2dd094e9 corrects that line. The clean review of the head c2dd094e9 is posted (19:53Z), by an agent that did not write the change. The request is thus closed, and its label goes with it.

The maintainer ordered the merge of this PR, and he accepted the light-lane reading (the "Maintainer decision" comments on #3556).

Merge class: no refresh. The head is the reviewed head. It is a process PR: a text change, with two `xtask` tests that pin the text (11 and 6 passed on this head). No heavy lane applies.

Review label `merge-ready`: the review at `c2dd094e9` has no blocker, the PR merges cleanly with `main` `64b737729`, and the touched xtask tests pass. `needs-rework` is removed; it was already absent on this head.
